test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FRISK’ Is written as ‘THLIQ’ and 'MOADS’ Is written as ‘QODQB’. How will ‘WAGER’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d34965cc19234d618281bb47da6a34df17079e24c3973f0130ad463e3604adf.png] 

The logic followed in the given code language:

‘FRISK’ Is written as ‘THLIQ’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d3b31f1fd671fe05d4318c1896a4dab44474a273f7fe6fe896aea7a1c01c550.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b917492f3e188635656ddb672aaa6eea99f7d86341ca55127f9773d1a3dbda6.png] 

'MOADS’ Is written as ‘QODQB’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbeb3ab0642ff563c3f240e474459faa57096047a4ac567bd13b96e97b979de8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fe1989a2cdac248b4e35d0ff597896fb73d6773a8fc42ec264c07dc66f72426.png] 

Similarly, ‘WAGER’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cb1c8a2bfcab16510c304faf32006107717796d92c051389f46e56f2174ce63.png] 

Here, 'WAGER' is written as** 'CYJPC'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
